name: LightCarbon LCG087S-D
why_interesting: The stem-routed LCG087 combines 47C clearance, micro suspension, storage and dropper support with a replaceable cockpit.
missing: Current mainland quote, exact included package and delivery route

price_status: quote only; current mainland price unverified

facts.frame: LCG087S-D gravel frameset with separate stem, micro suspension and downtube storage
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with internal routing through the stem
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-M frame; 1,450–1,510 g across S–L, ±40 g; fork 509 g ±15 g
facts.brakes: Flat-mount disc, 140 or 160 mm front and 160 mm rear
facts.storage: Downtube compartment for two optional 200 ml bags; lid retains bottle-cage mounts
facts.seatpost: 31.6 mm, dropper-post compatible; 0- or 25-mm-offset carbon post options
facts.suspension: Carbon-stay flex zones, elastomer and a small bearing pivot; travel is not published
facts.geometry: Reach 369–401 mm; stack 541.7–581.3 mm; 430 mm chainstays; 75 mm BB drop; official table lists 78.4–81.8 mm trail
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer describes controlled rear-stay flex through the elastomer-and-pivot system; no independent deflection or lateral-stiffness result is published

source_note: The current page's exact item number is LCG087S-D, not LCG073S-D. It preserves the exact stem-routed identity and documents the material, weights, 47C clearance, suspension, storage, dropper support, standards and geometry.
